prompt: A roaring horizontal wave of furnace-orange and white-hot flame sweeps across a muddy medieval battlefield, engulfing several creatures at once: a steel-armored knight, a hulking horned beast, and a small goblin are all caught mid-incineration, their bodies blackening to ash and bone, arms flung up, falling backward away from the blast. Embers and sparks fill the air. The only source of light is the rolling fire. The background is a dark smoke-choked dusk sky with charred ground.

A colossal roaring maw of molten fire erupts upward from a fissure in the cracked stone ground, a furnace-orange shockwave of flame rolling outward in every direction. Dark silhouettes of several creatures are thrown back through the air, limbs splayed, scorched to charcoal at the edges of the blast. Whirling embers and white-hot sparks. The only source of light is the eruption itself. The background is a black volcanic cavern with glowing cracks.

Wide aftermath of a firestorm: a scorched black battlefield strewn with the charred, smoldering silhouettes of fallen creatures, several still standing as crumbling ash-figures wreathed in dying orange flame and rising smoke. Drifting embers glow against the dark. The only source of light is the smoldering wreckage. The background is a furnace-orange heat-shimmer sky over distant burning ruins.

A row of several creatures, a steel-armored knight, a horned ogre, a wolf, and a goblin, all standing on a battlefield are simultaneously engulfed by a towering roaring wall of furnace-orange and yellow-white flame surging in from the right, their dark silhouettes blackening and crumbling, arms flung up. Swirling embers fill the air. The only light source is the wall of fire. The background is a dark smoke-filled sky and scorched earth.

Worm's-eye low-angle view from the scorched ground: several monstrous creatures loom overhead, all caught at the instant a roaring column of furnace fire bursts up between them, white-hot at the core, throwing their dark silhouettes apart, scorching their undersides to char. Cascading embers rain toward the viewer. The only light is the fire column. The background is a black sky streaked with smoke.

A vast dragon-like furnace head of pure roaring flame rears up and breathes a sweeping cone of fire across a battlefield, catching three or four creatures, an armored soldier, a beast, a goblin, in the blast, their dark bodies blackening and falling. Sparks and cinders scatter. The only light source is the roaring flame head. The background is a dim ash-grey battlefield under heavy smoke.

Close-up of a steel-armored knight and a snarling beast side by side, both consumed in a roaring burst of furnace-orange and white-hot flame that fills the frame, their faces and bodies blackening to char, mouths open in a scream, weapons dropping from their hands. Bright embers swirl. The only light source is the engulfing fire. The background is dark choking smoke.

A row of several creatures, a knight, a horned ogre, a wolf, a goblin, standing across a battlefield are simultaneously swallowed by a towering roaring curtain of furnace-orange and yellow-white flame surging in from behind, their dark silhouettes blackening and crumbling, arms thrown up. Whirling embers fill the air. The only light source is the wall of fire. The background is a smoke-darkened sky over scorched earth.

A roaring horizontal blast wave of furnace-orange flame tears across a battlefield from the left, several creatures, an armored knight, a hulking beast, a goblin, caught mid-air and flung backward to the right, their dark bodies scorched to charcoal, arms splayed. Streaking sparks and cinders trail behind them. The only light source is the blast. The background is a dark dusk sky and burnt ground.
